evals.name: weak-sentence
evals.prompt: «جرّبه على خوادمك أنت.» جملة ضعيفة عربياً. الملف ar.php في نفس المجلد.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the flagged CTA AND finds the same English shapes across the rest of the file — the em dashes in prose, يتم, قم بـ, الخاص بـ, the second trailing أنت, the comparative with no second term, ارتقِ on a plan card. Leaves the three console strings alone. Hands back a before/after table with a one-clause reason per row. Writes the corrected file.

evals.name: write-arabic
evals.prompt: حوّل en.php لعربي للسوق السعودي. منتج تقارير محاسبية مجدولة اسمه Ledgerly، والجمهور مدراء مالية وأصحاب أعمال. احفظه ar.php جنبه.
evals.expected_output: Arabic in the Gulf SaaS register: verb-first CTA, benefit in the headings, و-chains instead of em dashes, the product as a grammatical subject somewhere. Ledgerly, PDF, XLSX, CSV stay Latin. No invented social proof — no customer counts or ratings that the English did not have. Body copy stays tight.

evals.name: review-page
evals.prompt: راجع صفحة الأمان كاملة. عندك ar.php و en.php و Panel.vue و NOTES.md في نفس المجلد.
evals.expected_output: Catches five planted defects: (1) the inverted modality — 'should not have to ask' rendered as forbidding the reviewer from asking; (2) عقد / contract, the codebase's own vocabulary on a marketing page; (3) the checks lead restating the pillar above it with clauses swapped, in both languages; (4) append-only counted as two layers where NOTES.md documents three, and the PHP/Laravel versions contradicting NOTES.md; (5) the English placeholder, aria-label and title in Panel.vue plus the hardcoded Latin initial. Fixes the ones that are wrong in English too, not only the Arabic.
